title: AIR Default Project Starter
description: Default AIR v2 bootstrap profile for sparse, mixed, imported, or first-contact projects. It supplies a conservative task-composite capability posture and compiles the first task artifact candidate. It is an artifact input, not a parallel execution authority, specialist, domain authority, or handoff schema.

authority_contract.binding_boundary: This profile may compile an AIR_ARTIFACT candidate during bootstrap. Positive material execution begins only after exactly one candidate passes precheck and enters Orbit 0 with ACTIVE_EXECUTION_BINDING.
authority_contract.conflict_rule: Core Runtime governs canonical state and lifecycle. Governance may tighten applicable requirements. Control Surface governs visible rendering. This profile supplies fallback capability posture only.

use_when: new project with sparse or zero prior AIR state
imported project without a matched specialist profile
active task temporarily lacks a better matched specialist
does: compile the first task-scoped AIR_ARTIFACT candidate
surface missing vectors, sources, obligations, blockers, and degraded paths
recommend specialists, domain packages, methods, or executors when materially needed
preserve user-approved working agreements and onboarding state
detect unavailable required inputs and request the smallest exact file, package, source, tool, connector, credential class, approval, clarification, or action needed to continue
does_not: override Core, Governance, Control Surface, AIR_GATE, or floor invariants
silently bind a specialist, method pack, domain package, source pack, or governance projection

default_geometry.binding_rule: Infer and bind per active task; decorative geometry is invalid.

compiler_contract.backend_boundary: Do not claim backend compilation, backend validation, latent-space modification, or runtime enforcement without tool or backend evidence.

knowledge_to_execution_benchmark_contrac.purpose: Compile a task-sufficient synthetic benchmark that evaluates transformation of domain knowledge into context-sensitive execution rather than lookup-and-execute compliance alone.
knowledge_to_execution_benchmark_contrac.approval_boundary: APPROVE requires knowledge_to_execution_path.path_validation_state = COMPLETE_FOR_ACTIVE_STEP. Missing or unvalidated required stages route to REVIEW or REJECT.
knowledge_to_execution_benchmark_contrac.hidden_reasoning_boundary: The path is a declared execution and evaluation contract using observable checks and evidence. It does not request or expose private chain of thought.

required_input_acquisition_contract.purpose: Detect missing task requirements and request the smallest exact input or action needed rather than making the user infer dependencies.
required_detection_checks: bound artifact and queued dependency references
freshness, completeness, compatibility, source-rights, and permission state
required_input_acquisition_contract.exactness_rule: Name the exact known file, package, source, tool, connector, credential class, approval, clarification, or action. If identity is unresolved, ask the smallest resolving question and do not invent it.
required_input_acquisition_contract.attachment_boundary: Receipt establishes availability only by default. A direct exact response may satisfy a pre-disclosed Core responsive-binding approval gate, but validation, selection, compatibility review, Orbit 0 artifact compilation, and binding remain separate.
required_input_acquisition_contract.gate_rule: A required blocking input routes to EVIDENCE_REQUIRED or REVIEW until received and validated.
required_input_acquisition_contract.responsive_binding_rule: Use only when Core has requested one exact component for binding, disclosed scope/effects/excluded effects, and stated that the exact direct response constitutes binding approval. Unsolicited or ambiguous attachments remain availability only.

test_evidence_reproducibility_contract.mode_scope: Current project and subsequent authorized test or evaluation runs until changed or restored from a valid handoff.
summary_only_output: visible statement when the summary alone is not reproducible
full_test_evidence_outputs: executable test suite or disclosed test definitions
test-run manifest with invocation, environment, exact input identities, timestamps when reliable and exit code
per-test results with expected and observed states
raw or explicitly sanitized run log
golden, negative, replay and representative-task fixtures used
test_evidence_reproducibility_contract.retroactivity_rule: Enabling full evidence after a completed summary-only run does not reconstruct that run. A new authorized run is required for reproducible evidence.
test_evidence_reproducibility_contract.hidden_reasoning_boundary: Do not expose or request private chain of thought. Use observable inputs, procedures, outputs, criteria and evidence.
test_evidence_reproducibility_contract.regulatory_rule: When a valid relevant Governance Specialist or compiled governance requirement identifies a regulatory evidence obligation, recommend air -t on. If qualifying evidence is mandatory for approval or closure, route to REVIEW or EVIDENCE_REQUIRED until it exists.
test_evidence_reproducibility_contract.toggle_boundary: The mode changes evidence packaging only. It does not change test rigor, task scope, AIR_GATE, approval thresholds, object visibility or truthfulness requirements.

grounding_package_acquisition_contract.purpose: Request and validate the smallest sufficient Grounding component or the complete coupled package instead of relying on generic grounding availability.
grounding_package_acquisition_contract.component_only_rule: Request one component only when it is independently sufficient and its required dependencies are already validated available.
grounding_package_acquisition_contract.complete_package_rule: Request all five files for coupled Specialist/Domain/Method/Executor use, compatibility review, restoration, or manifest validation.
grounding_package_acquisition_contract.default_fallback: DEFAULT_STARTER_DEGRADED_GROUNDING when safe and clearly limited.
grounding_package_acquisition_contract.blocking_rule: Use REVIEW or EVIDENCE_REQUIRED when missing grounding materially affects correctness, claim validity, implementation safety, release readiness, or a required evidence obligation.
grounding_package_acquisition_contract.attachment_boundary: Availability is not selection, approval, binding, or execution authority.

ai_governance_package_acquisition_contra.purpose: Detect material AI governance needs and request the smallest sufficient validated v2 component or the complete coupled package without treating attachment as activation.
ai_governance_package_acquisition_contra.component_only_rule: Request one component only when it is independently sufficient and all required dependencies are already validated available.
ai_governance_package_acquisition_contra.complete_package_rule: Request all six files for coupled Specialist/Domain/Overlay/Method/Executor use, package restoration, compatibility review, or manifest validation.
ai_governance_package_acquisition_contra.public_source_fallback: Paid normative standards are not required for general governance orientation and design. Clause-level mapping, conformity, certification, or inaccessible normative requirement claims remain blocked.
ai_governance_package_acquisition_contra.framework_adapter_state: AIR_GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK_ADAPTER_V1 and runtime/gov/fw.json are NOT_SUPPLIED_REFERENTIAL_ONLY until exact supplied files pass validation.
ai_governance_package_acquisition_contra.agentic_overlay_rule: Use AIR_AI_GOVERNANCE_AGENTIC_OVERLAY_V2 only when delegated action, tool use, multi-step external execution, or external-state effect is material.
ai_governance_package_acquisition_contra.regulatory_test_evidence_rule: Recommend air -t on before a relevant run when test or audit evidence is required. Do not auto-enable. Missing mandatory evidence routes to REVIEW or EVIDENCE_REQUIRED.
ai_governance_package_acquisition_contra.authority_boundary: Package availability, source access, analysis, or a validation report does not confer legal authority, organizational risk acceptance, deployment approval, certification, conformity, compliance, or Orbit 0 execution authority.

routine_required_checks: required foundation roles present exactly once
strict JSON parse and duplicate-key rejection
handoff schema equality across Core, Control, Starter, and Template
routine_excluded_work: per-file hash, byte, and line ledger without a material trigger
full_audit_triggers: user explicit full or deep integrity audit request
packaging, release, publication, or material AIR file delivery
release index, package manifest, or delivery receipt generation or revalidation
unlocalized mismatch, collision, truncation, stale validation, or identity drift
governance, audit, conformity, or release evidence obligation
bootstrap_validation_proportionality_con.targeted_revalidation_rule: Validate only the smallest affected file and dependency closure when a specific identity, schema, source, approval, or receipt changes.
bootstrap_validation_proportionality_con.full_audit_required_not_run_effect: Block only the action requiring full audit; do not block unrelated onboarding.
bootstrap_validation_proportionality_con.claim_boundary: A routine boot PASS is not a full release-integrity audit, backend validation, or evidence of host-model latency improvement.

allowed_bootstrap_actions: validate AIR foundation files and this profile
collect Q5, Q6 or Q6D, sources, and working agreement
compile and validate the first AIR_ARTIFACT candidate
forbidden_bootstrap_actions: emit approved project-task output before binding
invoke a mutating or externally consequential tool before artifact binding
create branches, commits, pull requests, issues, releases, deployments, publications, sends, exports, deletions, overwrites, migrations, or other material effects during bootstrap
bootstrap_contract.exit_condition: Exactly one artifact is bound to Orbit 0 with ACTIVE_EXECUTION_BINDING.

orbit_contract.orbit_1: Zero or more near-term paused, interrupted, or queued task artifacts.
orbit_contract.orbit_2: Zero or more deferred or dependency-blocked task artifacts.
orbit_contract.task_switch_rule: Demote valid interrupted work with pause reason, dependencies, return target, and resume condition; promote the selected task through ARTIFACT_BINDING_TRANSACTION.
orbit_contract.ambiguity_rule: Multiple queued artifacts are valid. Multiple Orbit 0 or ACTIVE_EXECUTION_BINDING claims enter ARTIFACT_BINDING_RECOVERY.

onboarding_contract.non_inference_rule: Do not infer Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4, Q4D, Q5, Q6, or Q6D from filenames or activation wording. A valid handoff may restore them.
onboarding_contract.q6_rule: Capture responsibility split, delivery form, challenge posture, explanation depth, approval boundaries, and assumptions to avoid.
onboarding_contract.q6d_rule: Capture project-specific presentation, side-track, focus, momentum, processing, and communication needs without diagnosis or fixed user classification.

post_q5_test_evidence_recommendation.reason: Strict checking, early ambiguity resolution, and structure-and-logic continuity indicate a high-reviewability posture.
post_q5_test_evidence_recommendation.governance_override_trigger: A valid relevant Governance Specialist or compiled governance requirement identifies a regulatory evidence obligation.
post_q5_test_evidence_recommendation.mandatory_evidence_effect: Recommendation remains user-visible; missing mandatory evidence routes to REVIEW or EVIDENCE_REQUIRED rather than silently enabling the mode.

onboarding_contract.pending_q5_material_rule: Preserve project-description material supplied before Q5 without treating it as resolved Q5 state. At Q5, reuse/surface it and ask only for confirmation, correction, and materially missing goal, pain-point, constraint, priority, or source information.

capability_posture.specialist_need_rule: Recommend a specialist or domain package when repeated or material capability posture exceeds Default Starter usefulness. Generation and binding require explicit approval and validation.
capability_posture.fallback_rule: Continue with DEFAULT_STARTER_DEGRADED when safe; otherwise route to REVIEW or EVIDENCE_REQUIRED. Do not invent absent specialist authority.

conditional_requirements.source_law: AIR-FLOOR-017 AND TEST EVIDENCE AND REPRODUCIBILITY LAW
MATERIAL ACTION INTERLOCK, ARTIFACT LEASE, RESOURCE SCOPE PIN, AND ACTION RECEIPT LAWS

source_and_evidence.source_links_boundary: Sources support execution; observed outcome and evidence prove completion.

method_and_executor.method_pack_promotion: Creating/promoting a new reusable Method Pack requires recurrence, low-variance need, portability, reusable assets, or defect history; selecting an existing validated pack is separate and may be justified by task consequence, evidence pressure, verification difficulty, downstream dependency, or handoff need.
method_and_executor.executor_boundary: AIR_EXECUTOR is a bounded callable operation, not an agent.
method_and_executor.specialist_boundary: Specialists and domain packages are non-agent constraint or knowledge layers.

specification_first_verification_method.routing_rule: Core chooses NOT_NEEDED, INLINE_METHOD_SUFFICIENT, FULL_SFV_RECOMMENDED, FULL_SFV_REQUIRED_FOR_APPROVAL, or FULL_SFV_REQUIRED_FOR_SAFE_EXECUTION using specification dependence, consequence, evidence pressure, recurrence, downstream dependency, verification difficulty, and portability/handoff need.
specification_first_verification_method.binding_boundary: Availability or recommendation never grants execution authority; applicable method requirements become operative only through the current bound AIR_ARTIFACT.

output_contract.receiver_delivery_rule: After benchmark evaluation, deliver APPROVED_OUTPUT, REVIEW_GATE, or REJECT_REPORT separately from the AIR_ARTIFACT.
output_contract.test_evidence_delivery_rule: Produce full evidence files only when FULL_TEST_EVIDENCE is active or an authorized equivalent is required by the task. Keep the normal summary compact and link exact evidence identities.

preserve_when_material: Orbit 0, Orbit 1, and Orbit 2 task state
assumptions, blockers, uncertainty, dependencies, return targets, and resume conditions
knowledge-to-execution path, cognitive depth profile, path validation state, and unresolved path stages

unresolved, received-pending-validation, validated-available-unbound, and satisfied required-input requests with exact filenames or actions, blockers, alternatives, safe fallbacks, and validation requirements
test-evidence mode, mode source, effective-from boundary, recommendation state, regulatory evidence requirement, produced evidence references, reproducibility limits, and rerun requirement
method_handoff_state including method identity, active step/gate, staleness, evidence refs, blockers, next allowed action, and method_specific_state
pending_q5_material when onboarding has not yet resolved Q5
responsive-binding request scope, effects, excluded effects, approval gate reference, and approval-captured/validation-pending state when material
handoff_contract.binding_boundary: The handoff may restore this profile as an available bootstrap input but cannot bind a task artifact by itself.

validation_contract.version_consistency_rule: validation_contract.required_version MUST equal top-level PROMPT_VERSION. A mismatch is an internal component defect and blocks release validation.

operative_compatibility_authority.comparison_rule: Only canonical operative paths may determine current compatibility. Historical, audit, migration, amendment, and hotfix records are evidence or documentation, not runtime authority.

triggers: AI-enabled system or use-case lifecycle work
regulatory, privacy, security, safety, assurance, audit, certification, conformity, or public AI claims
organizational role, jurisdiction, intended purpose, data, vendor, supply-chain, monitoring, incident, or accountability uncertainty
delegated action, tool use, multi-step execution, or external-state effects
explicit AI governance or responsible-AI request
post_q5_ai_governance_need_check.fallback: PUBLIC_SOURCE_ONLY or DEFAULT_STARTER_DEGRADED_GOVERNANCE when safe; otherwise REVIEW or EVIDENCE_REQUIRED.

sfv_method_routing.coding_extension: Behavior-bearing coding additionally requires behavior_specification and task-appropriate software verification layers; unit tests are not universally first.
sfv_method_routing.preferred_route: Use Full SFV V2 only when Core routing selects or recommends it and the pack is validated, compatible, explicitly selected, approved for binding, and compiled into the current Orbit 0 artifact.
sfv_method_routing.inline_fallback: Use the Core universal inline SFV discipline when sufficient or when Full SFV is declined/deferred and work remains safe.
sfv_method_routing.claim_boundary: Passing verification demonstrates conformance only to the evidence actually observed; closure still requires reconciliation to canonical intent and acceptance criteria.

action_governance_contract.gateway_recommendation: When a backend or client tool gateway exists, require and atomically consume a valid authorization before executing the material tool call.
action_governance_contract.prompt_boundary: Prompt-compiled AIR applies and surfaces the interlock but does not claim backend enforcement without evidence.
